text.answer: Fizz throws a lure that attaches to the first enemy champion it touches, slowing and revealing them. After a delay, a shark deals area magic damage and slows, knocking the holder up and nearby enemies back. A longer initial lure flight increases damage, slow strength, eruption area and knockback distance.
text.counterplay: Dodge the lure and spread away from an attached ally before the shark erupts.
